examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The footer composed with four link columns, then the bottom bar in one row: the Azion mark and the social icons at the start, the status indicator and the language select at the end. Below md the bar stacks, the mark and icons over the status and language, and the columns fold to two.

examples.name: SitePlacement
examples.summary: The footer under a marketing page: it spans the page like the site header, opens on a plain full-width rule like the header's, with no corner marks, and insets its columns and bottom bar to the header measure so they line up under the header's brand.

examples.name: Console
examples.summary: The slim console bar: the Azion mark, the column's links on one line (the column title names the navigation for assistive tech), and the status and language at the end. It wraps to a second row on a narrow screen.
